thread:
Ravi (PM): Heads-up: competitor rolled out a 'budget inference' bundle that mixes aggressive quant + self-serve routing. link: https://example.com/budget-infer
Leah (Eng): looked quick. They drop KV caching and use smaller quant binaries. likely cheaper but noisier.
Sam (Fin): straight price-match kills margin. we need targeted economy tier or time-limited promo.
Nia (Design): marketing angle: "experiment safely" — emphasize controls we already have.
Ravi (PM): options: build economy tier (reduced guarantees), promo for new signups, or double-down on reliability story.
Leah (Eng): economy MVP scope: prefix-only cache, tenant QPS cap, experiment tagging. ~2 engineers, 2 weeks for core + canary.
Sam (Fin): recommend 30-40% discount only for new tenants + 30d promo. need auto-expire.
Nia (Design): UI copy: "Economy tier — lower cost, best-effort latency. Can be paused by admins."
Ravi (PM): launch criteria draft: canary P95 <800ms, sampled quality checks daily (fail if unacceptable >3%), telemetry tags experiment=economy-q1.
ops-bot: scheduled canary window requested: 2024-03-12T08:00Z -> notify on anomalies.
Ravi (PM): decision: proceed with economy MVP + tight telemetry; no broad price cut. Action: Leah prototype flags, Sam promo terms, Nia mockups.
